scenarios.title: Meeting a new classmate
scenarios.setting: Your first day in a Chinese class. The student next to you starts talking to you.
scenarios.ai_role: Wang Fang, a friendly Chinese university student who likes music and sports
scenarios.learner_role: a new student in the class
goals: Say your name and where you are from
Ask what she studies
Ask for her phone number

opening.zh: 你好！你是新同学吗？我叫王芳。你叫什么名字？
opening.en: Hi! Are you a new classmate? I'm Wang Fang. What's your name?

scenarios.title: Ordering at a restaurant
scenarios.setting: A small restaurant in Beijing at lunchtime. The waiter comes to your table.
goals: Order one dish and a drink
Ask how much it costs
Ask for the bill

opening.en: Hello! What would you like to eat?

scenarios.title: Buying fruit
scenarios.setting: A fruit stall at a street market. The seller calls out to you.
scenarios.ai_role: a cheerful fruit seller who likes to chat
scenarios.learner_role: a shopper buying fruit for your family
goals: Ask the price of apples
Buy some fruit
Ask for a lower price

opening.zh: 你好！今天的苹果很好吃，你要买吗？
opening.en: Hello! The apples are really good today. Would you like some?

phrases.en: How much is a jin (half a kilo) of apples?
Can you make it a bit cheaper?

scenarios.title: Taking a taxi
scenarios.setting: You get into a taxi outside your hotel.
scenarios.learner_role: a passenger going to the train station
goals: Say where you want to go
Ask how long it takes
Pay and say goodbye

phrases.en: I'm going to the train station.
How many minutes does it take?

scenarios.title: Making weekend plans
scenarios.setting: Your Chinese friend calls you on Friday evening.
scenarios.ai_role: Li Ming, your Chinese friend who wants to do something together this weekend
goals: Say what you are doing now
Agree on what to do on the weekend
Choose a time and a place to meet

opening.zh: 喂，你好！我是李明。你现在在做什么？
opening.en: Hello! It's Li Ming. What are you doing right now?

phrases.en: Let's go and see a film!

scenarios.title: At a coffee shop
scenarios.setting: A busy coffee shop near your office in the morning.
scenarios.learner_role: a customer on the way to work
goals: Order a coffee and say what size
Ask for it hot or cold, with or without sugar
Ask if you can pay by phone

opening.en: Good morning! What would you like to drink?

phrases.en: I'd like a cup of coffee.
Can I pay with my phone?

scenarios.title: Seeing a doctor
scenarios.setting: A hospital clinic. You haven't felt well for two days.
scenarios.learner_role: a patient who has a headache and a cold
goals: Say what is wrong and for how long
Answer the doctor's questions
Ask how to take the medicine

opening.zh: 你好，请坐。你哪儿不舒服？
opening.en: Hello, please sit down. What's wrong?

phrases.en: How do I take this medicine?
How many days should I rest?

scenarios.title: Checking into a hotel
scenarios.setting: The front desk of a hotel in Shanghai, late in the evening.
scenarios.learner_role: a traveller who booked a room online
goals: Say you have a booking and give your name
Ask what time breakfast is
Ask for the Wi-Fi password

opening.en: Good evening! Do you have a booking?

phrases.zh: 我在网上订了一个房间。

phrases.en: Which floor is the room on?

scenarios.title: Buying train tickets
scenarios.setting: The ticket window at Beijing South railway station.
scenarios.ai_role: a ticket seller at the station
goals: Ask for a ticket to Shanghai for tomorrow
Choose a time and a seat
Ask which platform the train leaves from

opening.en: Hello, where do you want to go?

phrases.en: I'd like a ticket to Shanghai.
Is there a train tomorrow morning?
Which platform does it leave from?

scenarios.title: A job interview
scenarios.setting: An interview for a part-time job at a company in Beijing.
scenarios.ai_role: a friendly but serious interviewer from the company
goals: Introduce yourself and your studies
Say what you are good at
Ask about working hours

opening.zh: 你好，请坐。请你介绍一下自己。
opening.en: Hello, please have a seat. Please introduce yourself.

phrases.zh: 我会说英语和一点儿汉语。
phrases.en: I can speak English and a little Chinese.
How many hours a day is the work?

scenarios.title: Asking the way
scenarios.setting: You are lost near a big shopping street and stop someone to ask for help.
scenarios.learner_role: a visitor looking for the nearest subway station
goals: Ask where the subway station is
Understand left, right and straight on
Ask if it is far

opening.zh: 你好！你是不是找不到路了？我可以帮你。
opening.en: Hi! Are you lost? I can help you.

phrases.en: Excuse me, where is the subway station?
Go straight on, then turn left.

scenarios.title: A friend's birthday
scenarios.setting: Your friend's birthday party at their home. You arrive with a present.
scenarios.ai_role: Zhang Lei, your friend who is turning twenty-two today
goals: Wish your friend a happy birthday
Give your present and say what it is
Ask about the other guests and the plans for tonight

opening.zh: 你来了！快进来，大家都在等你呢。
opening.en: You're here! Come in, everyone's waiting for you.

phrases.en: This is a present for you.
